_comment: Food banks whose OWN locations page is the authority for their centres. Re-scraped on every 3x-daily refresh (scripts/own_locations.py via build.py) and every daily deep sweep (sweep_daily.py). Each centre on the page becomes a pin with the page's address, postcode and Mon-Sun times; that food bank's Give Food location pins not on the page are dropped. Fail-safe: if the page fails or parses fewer than min_centres, the last good snapshot (overrides/foodbank_own_pages.json) is used and nothing is dropped. Added 22 Oct 2026 from Katy at Coventry Foodbank's email.

bournemouth._added: 28 Oct 2026 (Dean, PR #243): each hub's own line on its centre block; 6 centres on the page

northern-devon._added: 28 Oct 2026 (Dean, PR #243): South Molton and the other centres' own lines; 7 centres on the page
